Uruguay Names Squad for Match Against India

Uruguay has announced a preliminary 46-man squad for an upcoming match against India. Coach Diego Forlan has selected the team, with no indication of a return for player Luis Suarez. The specific details of the match, including the date and venue, were not provided in the coverage.
